programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Another remarkable journey for Chris. This time he travels to the remote parts of northern Kenya to see the work of a brave Aussie zoo keeper fighting to save some of the world’s most endangered animals. In this extraordinary episode, Chris treats an orphaned baby rhino, takes cover from gunfire as an anti poaching squad hunts down a killer and saves the life of a badly mauled goat. Plus the Bondi Vet meets some amazing women and finds out how their beautiful beads are saving wildlife and gets involved with a crazy jumping competition with some Masai warriors.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris Brown and Dr Lisa Chimes head out to the burnt regions of the Blue Mountains on the Sydney outskirts the day after some of the most intense bushfires on record. The mass evacuations of farms and properties have left animals injured, stranded or in distress. The Bondi Vet team take to the road to help where they can. The last thing Chris expected was to be treating a baby alpaca named Jersey. Jersey’s mother went into premature labour, brought on by the stressful evacuation of the herd from their fire threatened property. Now the new-born Cria (baby alpaca) is listless and deteriorating alarming.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this episode of Bondi Vet, Georgie, a small rescue dog, is brought in to see Dr Chris Brown. Georgie has a massive growth on her leg and Chris discovers another lump that is possibly more sinister. she will need an immediate, marathon operation that Chris hopes the dog can survive.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is heading to the Halls Gap Zoo in Western Victoria where Stephanie the Lemur awaits. Recently the keepers have noticed her left canine tooth has darkened and are concerned it is an infection that could become a major problem for the small Lemur, especially as they suspect she may be pregnant.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris has received a call from Tim Faulkner at the Australian Reptile Park. One of the parks kangaroo’s has a nasty lump under its chin and Chris needs to make an emergency dash to the park to perform an urgent operation, that is made more difficult as the roo is a mother with young joey.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: “It doesn’t get much better than this” is one of the first things that Dr Chris says when a 4 week old baby lion cub Zambi is brought into the Bondi Clinic. For safety reasons Zambi has had to be removed from her mother by carers Donna and Mandy from the animal welfare organization LOTL (Life On The Line) Rescue. Not only does the young lion require a medical checkup but she also needs a surrogate mother and Dr Chris has the perfect – while very strange solution. No one is sure if it will work.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is in Cairns, a place he loves because no case is ever straightforward in the tropics and he is not disappointed. His first case is to try to solve the mystery medical condition of Snoopy, a Jack Russell terrier, who at odd times suffers strange and potentially deadly attacks.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is still in Cairns working as a locum at the local Marlin Coast Vet Clinic and yet again the tropic north does not disappoint when it come the weird and wild animals. First up, Chris is called to a local crocodile park to treat Ted, a 5.4 metre monster with savage wounds to his snout after coming off second best in a fight.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is shocked when a wild Currawong that has been speared by a wooden skewer is brought into the clinic. The spear has been in place for a number of weeks and new skin is growing around the spear, which must be removed but Chris is concerned that the shock of surgery may kill the wild bird.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pluto the singing Dalmatian has lost his voice and Chris fears that the cause may be sinister. Pluto is very special to Chris because he was one of Chris’ first every patients.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is confronted by Benji, a small dog with a large heart murmur that Chris can feel before he even hears it. Without immediate surgery young Benji could die at any moment and Chris entrusts this tricky operation to the one person he knows can pull it off – Dr Andrew Marchevsky at SASH.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has returned to Hamilton in country Victoria at the invitation of Hamilton Animal Health Clinic. As the city vet it’s hardly surprising that they give him the more unusual cases to deal with including Pepper, a pig that delivers still born piglets, twin foals where one is being rejected by its mother and a visit to a farm to test the fertility of their massive stud bulls by measuring the size of their jewels.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris needs to use all his detective skills to find out why the end of Zaza, a pygmy bearded dragon’s tail keeps mysteriously falling off.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Back at the Bondi Clinic small West Highland Terrier Mr Pettibone arrives on the back of owner Henry’s Harley Davidson Motorcycle. The bikie dog has a persistent ear problem and Chris thinks he has the perfect solution.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is called out to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne to deal with an extremely rare case - Charity the lamb was born without hooves on her right side and without some form of intervention her life will be cut short. Chris suggests something untried on a sheep in Australia - prosthetics hooves.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris is called out to visit 42 year old Galah Pretty, who has a fast growing lump on his leg that is deeply concerning to owner Maurizio. Even though surgery on the old bird could kill it Maurizio is not keen on Chris’ alternative.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: When miniature goat Monty enters the Bondi Clinic the vet nurses are all smitten until they discovery what the cute 4 week old is harbouring on his skin!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Miniature Horse Charlie has a severe problem with his mouth that Chris needs to investigate, but getting access to the tiny creatures teeth becomes a near impossible task.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris receives a call from a Melbourne school principal. She has a 4 month old staffy called Juno whose health is deteriorating rapidly. Chris brings to the dog to Sydney to get a CT scan to find out what is happening with the young pup and what they discover is something so rare, only 20 cases have been recorded world wide. Juno’s blood vessels are all mixed up, and she requires a very high-risk surgery to have any chance of survival.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ziggy the cat has a big problem – he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats deteriorating health is not compromised further.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this very special program the Bondi Vet travels to England to fulfill a dream he has always had about working in the UK. He is invited to join a clinic in Cornwall where he is presented with all sorts of animals great and small. From a diary calf requiring urgent surgery, to a prize winning duck with a torn foot that needs to be repaired in time for her next showing. He also treats a large Siberian Eagle Owl that requires an operation to fix a bad eye and must give the all clear to release two Atlantic Grey Seals that were washed up in recent storms.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3 day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum, and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumour.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has been invited to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital. The hospital is for sick and injured falcons, and they are treated like royalty. Chris has to preform delicate surgery on a falcon wing.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A tiny kitten has been found abandoned in a cardboard box, and Chris is shocked at the extent of her injuries. She desperately needs surgery to try to repair her shattered leg. Then it's a heartwarming search to find her a new home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The finale to Chris's trip is an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters. He's then allowed into the most sacred area of all - the panda kindergarten to meet the adorable babies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anaesthetised so Chris can investigate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. The brave little battler needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has travelled to the Cook Island to help out at a busy vet clinic in the capital Rarotonga. His first patient is Princess, a hit run victim. Chris quickly finds out just how tough it is looking after the local pets, with only basic facilities and limited supplies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Three month old rescue puppy Tyson is being fostered by a family for just one week. But when foster Mum, Melissa takes the puppy to Chris for a routine check up she is confronted with terrible news. Tyson needs major heart surgery or he will die. Despite the expense, the family decide to adopt Tyson because they know no one else will give him a home in his condition. Will Tyson survive the openheart surgery and have a happy future with his new family?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has rushed to the Australian Reptile Park to handle an emergency. Two Tasmanian devil babies, Lara and Lily have been struck down with a mystery illness and are close to death. Can Chris save the two critically ill sisters or is the entire devil population at the park in danger of being wiped out?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two boxer puppies are found by police wandering the streets. One has been hit by a car and is coughing up blood. Chris is called to rescue the brothers. First, he must treat the hit run victim but then it becomes his mission to track down their owners and prevent them going to an animal shelter. The trouble is Chris is bonding with the puppies and is going to find it hard to let go.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A miniature horse who is suffering from dwarfism disease was not meant to survive past six months. However his loving owner and a dedicated band of vets have beaten the odds and kept 2 year old Koda alive. Australia’s smallest horse is also a regular visitor at the Royal Children’s Hospital in Melbourne and lights up the lives of hundreds of sick kids. Now, however, the brave Koda faces another life threatening operation. Chris will be part of the elite surgical team that will decide Koda’s fate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two heartbroken little girls and their Mum are pleading for Dr Chris to save their beloved bunny. The family came home to find something shocking had happened to little Alice. The rabbit is the girls’ first pet and only 14 weeks old. This will be one of Dr Chris’ toughest cases.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful kelpie is brought to Chris in a terrible state. A knock to the head as a puppy has caused severe balance problems but his condition is now deteriorating rapidly. His loving owner Heidi already has a baby to look after but she is constantly assisting Jasper and cannot bear the thought of losing him. In desperation, she looks to Chris for an answer. A brain scan shows his problems are inoperable but Chris refuses to give in. A custom made cart is fitted for Jasper and the sight of him moving about with his new “ wheels” is a heart warming salute to love and persistence.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Jen brings in her son’s dog Jewel to Dr Chris to find out if she’s expecting. The complication? This is an unplanned pregnancy and Jen suspects the father is her own dog, Token. X rays prove Jewel is having a football team of puppies. Get ready for a long night of anxiety, sadness and ultimately joy as Dr Chris helps Jewel through her ordeal. Funny scenes as proud father, Token keeps a close eye on proceedings to make sure his offspring are being well looked after.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner, Allison loves Lola and has asked Chris to find a way to stop the execution. A new nose ring is the answer. Sounds easy but sedating an angry pig turns out to be a tough challenge. Watch out for some hilarious chase scenes.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Honey has taken a death-defying leap out of a car doing 40 kms an hour to chase down a cat. Somehow the spoodle has survived but just how serious are her injuries? Owner, Ilana is suffering enormous guilt that she didn’t have the family’s pride and joy safety strapped in the car. Watch for the cat hating spoodle’s reaction when she hears her archenemies out the back of the Bondi clinic.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour. What has the huge python swallowed that is now threatening to kill him? This a case of truth being stranger then fiction.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan’s horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is about to be confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. Twelve-year old Elliot’s much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive, cancerous tumour. But surgery on such a pint-sized patient is going to be a real challenge. Will Pinot pull through or will a young girl be shattered?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well ...try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pearl was at her regular hairdressing appointment when she started bleeding internally. Now the pampered poodle may have minutes to live and Chris is her only hope.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Lucu has been attacked by a paralysis tick and the poison is rapidly shutting down her system. A round the clock watch is needed to keep this innocent victim alive. But will it be enough?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer and will she ever be able to fly?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emotional case for Chris as he fights to save one of the clinic’s favourite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now Bluebell is the victim of a hit run accident and all the staff at Bondi are directly affected.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It’s all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked the five year old and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of Tigger’s injuries.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us its like “ a third testicle swinging in the wind.” But when it comes to surgery it’s no laughing matter for Chris.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate. Lucky to survive, he has now endured seven operations to try to fix the gaping hole in his mouth. All have failed and time is running out. Chronic infections are now destroying his quality of life. Like Boris, his owner Jess is refusing to give up. She’s written to Chris looking for one last chance. The surgery will be the first of its type ever performed in Australia. Eight thousand dollars needs to be raised and Chris is prepared to go all the way for Boris!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone and end up in serious trouble. What can Dr Chris come up with to tame the savage terrier?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing. Chris is immediately concerned that Small One may have a skin cancer.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris makes a special trip to Karara in Queensland to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris travels to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne, where he is faced with a very woolly fugitive. Ben Hall is a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick, matted wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is visiting remote Christmas Island where he has to help a seabird named Bill that is unable to fly. Bill is a rare Abbott’s Booby, and she's missing critical flight feathers. Chris needs to treat Bill's deformed wing, before starting rehabilitation with the young rescue bird.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tim wants Chris to find out why Jack the koala has suddenly developed nasty bumps all over his face. Chris is so concerned, they take the little 2 year old to the local clinic for an immediate biopsy. When the results come back Tim is astonished to learn that Jack has acne.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A dairy buffalo called Penny has severely deformed horns, which are growing into her skull, dangerously close to her brain. Chris has to try to corral the timid 10 year old, and then carry out the painstaking job of carefully removing the horns.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is heading out to sea, to help try to save an endangered Grey Nurse shark, which has been spotted entangled in fishing line and with a hook stuck in its mouth. A specialist rescue team has been assembled and Chris is joining them in the water, to try to corral the injured shark so it can be brought to the surface.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns. His first patient is a young dog which has had a nasty encounter with a hedgecutter. Misty has ended up with deep cuts across her nose. How the young dog avoided more disastrous injuries is a miracle.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns, and his first patient is a rare Fijian iguana Called Ako. The Iguana hasn't been himself, and isn't eating properly. Chris needs to do an x-ray to try to work out what's going on. The results reveal a massive bladder stone inside the small animal, and he needs immediate surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A little joey has been brought in to Chris at the Bondi clinic after its mother was hit and killed by a car. It's feared the frail orphan may have a broken leg, but carer Sandy is determined to give the little battler a chance. It's a huge challenge for Chris to try to repair the leg. It's a heart stopping moment when he finds if the risky surgery has been a success.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew investigates a worrying lump on a horse for a possible killer disease, but can he get close enough to find out. And Doctor Rachel is feeling the pressure when a passionate wildlife warrior brings in two distressed little Aussies.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew must make a life and death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode a critically ill kangaroo infant has Andrew and the young joey’s rescuer worried for its life. Dr Romi has her hand full with eight lively puppies, but will they get a clean bill of health?

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode delicate surgery has Andrew anxious for Sally the cow’s future. And why is doctor Romi so over the moon?

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet ER Luna has been rushed in to Alex with shocking injuries, Gerardo desperately tries to save a new born puppy, and a sock has gone missing and Ollie is facing serious trouble.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Billy answers an SOS from farmers in North Queensland who have lost chickens to a giant snake. Rob performs surgery on a German Shepherd with a broken leg. Michael removes a strange growth from a beloved African pygmy hedgehog .

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Billy has a close call with the worlds biggest crocodile during a health check. Michael comes up with a plan to treat a kittens life-threatening pelvic issues. Rescue cat Thor needs Robs help to fix a severely blocked bladder.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Rob treats a horrific lump growing behind dachshund Leos eye. Billy has a battle trying to find a snake that has been seen dangerously close to a family home. A Maltese Shih tzu is rushed to emergency with possible tick paralysis.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Rob performs surgery on a greyhound puppy with a badly fractured leg. The team at SASH has to fit 8-year-old cat, Bubby with a pacemaker. Ewan performs surgery on French bulldog Tyson, who is rushed to emergency with sudden paralysis.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Billy removes an object stuck down the throat of a giant alligator, but its not a job for the faint hearted. 13 year old French Bulldog Piglet faces a life and death battle. And a cat is badly injured after being hit by a car.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Its double trouble for Dr Rob as he treats 2 meerkats and neither likes going to the vet. Louisa has to work out how to get close enough to treat an aggressive bull terrier. James must perform high tech surgery to fix a shocking deformity.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Mara treats a cat suffering severe breathing difficulties and makes a surprise discovery. A labrador is going downhill fast with severe heatstroke and Dr Olivia has her work cut out when confronted with a pet python.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Roxy the Groodle faces major surgery . Audrey steps right out of her comfort zone to conduct health checks on two adult cheetahs. Miniature poodle Bert has warts all over his body that need to be removed to improve quality of life.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet a tense night in the ER as Chris fights to save a policeman’s pet which has been deliberately poisoned with snail bait . Add to that a mercy mission for a malnourished penguin washed up on Bondi beach and a scary operation for a seven month old pup whose leg is disintegrating.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In Episode 2 of Bondi Vet, Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12 year old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There’s also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: This week stand by for a ground breaking operation at the Bondi clinic. Elroy, the out of control bulldog is being desexed and Chris is about to give him the very latest fake silicone testicles direct from the United States. Lisa hopes a blood transfusion can save a senior citizen and some very different patients including a sick owl spreading some nasty bugs and a turtle that’s wandered way off track.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this episode you will lose your heart to a brave golden retriever and her devoted owner.Rosie has severely deformed legs and only major surgery can save her life. How will owner Angus find the money and will the operation work? Chris also introduces us to one of Bondi’s most delightful dog loving eccentrics and a cutting edge solution for a record breaking goat.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: You will never forget Chris’ desperate fight to save the life of an innocent hit run victim. Lisa helps little Zoe battle a poisonous snake bite, we follow a lame lorikeet learning to fly again and the power of puppy school.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this episode a much loved Labrador in trouble after a head on collision with a car and Lisa is in a race against time to find the cause of a mystery illness that is threatening the life of a five month old kitten. As well, Chris heads to the bush and gets called out to help with a difficult birth.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An unforgettable story as Chris takes home a fragile baby kangaroo with the odds against him….. will the joey make it without his mum? Plus a helping hand for a puppy with a life threatening problem. And Chris confronts his archenemy…a chihuahua with a mean streak.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: This week, follow Chris behind bars and meet three beautiful pups who are changing prisoners’ lives, a terrible ordeal for a pregnant beagle as Lisa struggles to save her life, a bunny that makes the Bondi vet cry and surfing lessons for Chris’ kelpie…Rusty.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: So ugly he’s cute! Meet sharpei puppy, Mr Wilson who is running the risk of going blind because of the massive folds of fat that hang over his eyes. Chris is hoping an eyelift will allow Mr Wilson to finally see the world.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris tackles a tricky rescue mission to try to save a mother and her three ducklings. The family have set up home in a disused swimming pool at a building site but the pool is full of rubbish and one duckling has already died. A new address is needed urgently but catching these submersive creatures is going to be very difficult.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An eight month old kitten’s back legs have been shattered by a deliberate act of cruelty. Can Chris save eight month old Blackie?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two peregrine falcons that live at the top of a high rise shopping centre mall in busy Bondi Junction have been struck down with a mystery illness. Can Chris find the answer and return the beautiful birds to their penthouse home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris faces one of the most traumatic nights of his career when Bella the pug is rushed into the Bondi clinic. She is in labour and x rays show she’s carrying six huge puppies. During an emergency caesarean Chris and a team of vet nurses battle to save the babies and a critical Bella.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two kooky cousins are worried their spoilt Pomeranian, Marie has swallowed some string from a bikini. Six month old Marie is vomiting and in pain and Chris has to try to diagnose the case while Hilary and Genevieve re decorate the clinic! Finally little Marie has to go to surgery and the girls are not coping. Watch for a whacky homecoming.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A mother duck has decided to hatch her nine babies on a high rise balcony. It’s a terrible choice. There’s no food, water or shelter from the sun and no way of getting out. Rounding them up is Chris’ first problem but their lives are in danger again when the release doesn’t go according to plan.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the bush this episode to try to sort out an intriguing call for help. Schnitzel is a sixteen month old daschund with a crazy obsession that’s putting his life in danger. Schnitzel won’t leave the new born calves alone and is in real danger of getting a kick to the head. The determined dog has already been trodden on and suffered a broken toe. Watch for farmer Scott’s scepticism about the vet’s left field solution. There’s also a mercy dash to help a calf with a fractured leg.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emergency night call for Chris as a little schnoodle (cross schnauzer and poodle) is rushed in after being run over by a taxi on a busy road. Distressed baby sitters, Brad and Thomas have been looking after Toby while his owners are holidaying in Queensland. The accident victim is traumatised and suffering from a punctured lung. Can Chris save Toby or will Brad and Thomas have to make a terrible phone call?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A case close to Lisa’s heart. Seven month old Danny nearly died from a paralysis tick bite when he was just a few weeks old. Now he’s back at Sash struggling to walk and breath. His doting owners think their precious golden retriever puppy has swallowed something but Lisa discovers Danny’s life is under threat once again.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris turns detective to find out how the tiny Splodge is managing to escape from his backyard by climbing straight up a three metre brick fence. The neighbours are all happy to see the little Houdini but Splodge is dicing with death. He’s already been run over once and had his leg broken. What will the spy cameras reveal and how can Chris outsmart the cunning Splodge.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A four week old lamb with a broken leg has been dumped at an animal farm. Chris has decided little Leroy deserves a shot at life and takes the lamb back to the clinic to try to save his fractured leg and his life. Watch for Leroy’s introduction to Bondi Beach where Chris passes him off as a brand new breed of lamb-radoodle.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Sydney is being lashed by a huge storm and a tiny penguin has been washed up on Bondi beach. The little fella is malnourished and having trouble standing up. When Chris discovers what is causing the problem, he is shocked and forced to make a tough decision. Watch for the Bondi vet committing a fashion crime with some very floral board shorts.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris leads an Australian vet team overseas to help the animal victims of Fiji’s devastating cyclone. Working with him is his Dad, Graeme, a vet with 42 years experience. Together they stitch up a horse which has been ripped apart by a piece of flying corrugated iron roof. Watch out for some interesting family disagreements. Lisa has to make the adjustment from her hi tech hospital at home to treating animals in primitive conditions. Chris is also invited to an exclusive island resort to treat a cantankerous 170 kg pet pig. Unforgettable.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A hit run victim collapses in a designer dress shop. Willow, a seven year old Husky, can only drag herself along the ground. Chris comes to the rescue but will Willow ever be able to walk again?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has a second call out. This time, it’s a Norwich terrier struggling to deliver her first litter of pups. It’s an emotional rollercoaster as Chris tries to save the puppies and keep the mother alive. The eight hour drama ends with a dash to the Bondi clinic for emergency surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Three month old rescue puppy Tyson is being fostered by a family for just one week. But when foster Mum, Melissa takes the puppy to Chris for a routine check up she is confronted with terrible news. Tyson needs major heart surgery or he will die. Despite the expense, the family decide to adopt Tyson because they know no one else will give him a home in his condition. Will Tyson survive the openheart surgery and have a happy future with his new family?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has rushed to the Australian Reptile Park to handle an emergency. Two Tasmanian devil babies, Lara and Lily have been struck down with a mystery illness and are close to death. Can Chris save the two critically ill sisters or is the entire devil population at the park in danger of being wiped out?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two boxer puppies are found by police wandering the streets. One has been hit by a car and is coughing up blood. Chris is called to rescue the brothers. First, he must treat the hit run victim but then it becomes his mission to track down their owners and prevent them going to an animal shelter. The trouble is Chris is bonding with the puppies and is going to find it hard to let go.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A miniature horse who is suffering from dwarfism disease was not meant to survive past six months. However his loving owner and a dedicated band of vets have beaten the odds and kept 2 year old Koda alive. Australia’s smallest horse is also a regular visitor at the Royal Children’s Hospital in Melbourne and lights up the lives of hundreds of sick kids. Now, however, the brave Koda faces another life threatening operation. Chris will be part of the elite surgical team that will decide Koda’s fate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two heartbroken little girls and their Mum are pleading for Dr Chris to save their beloved bunny. The family came home to find something shocking had happened to little Alice. The rabbit is the girls’ first pet and only 14 weeks old. This will be one of Dr Chris’ toughest cases.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful kelpie is brought to Chris in a terrible state. A knock to the head as a puppy has caused severe balance problems but his condition is now deteriorating rapidly. His loving owner Heidi already has a baby to look after but she is constantly assisting Jasper and cannot bear the thought of losing him. In desperation, she looks to Chris for an answer. A brain scan shows his problems are inoperable but Chris refuses to give in. A custom made cart is fitted for Jasper and the sight of him moving about with his new “ wheels” is a heart warming salute to love and persistence.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Jen brings in her son’s dog Jewel to Dr Chris to find out if she’s expecting. The complication? This is an unplanned pregnancy and Jen suspects the father is her own dog, Token. X rays prove Jewel is having a football team of puppies. Get ready for a long night of anxiety, sadness and ultimately joy as Dr Chris helps Jewel through her ordeal. Funny scenes as proud father, Token keeps a close eye on proceedings to make sure his offspring are being well looked after.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner, Allison loves Lola and has asked Chris to find a way to stop the execution. A new nose ring is the answer. Sounds easy but sedating an angry pig turns out to be a tough challenge. Watch out for some hilarious chase scenes.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Honey has taken a death-defying leap out of a car doing 40 kms an hour to chase down a cat. Somehow the spoodle has survived but just how serious are her injuries? Owner, Ilana is suffering enormous guilt that she didn’t have the family’s pride and joy safety strapped in the car. Watch for the cat hating spoodle’s reaction when she hears her archenemies out the back of the Bondi clinic.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour. What has the huge python swallowed that is now threatening to kill him? This a case of truth being stranger then fiction.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan’s horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is about to be confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. Twelve-year old Elliot’s much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive, cancerous tumour. But surgery on such a pint-sized patient is going to be a real challenge. Will Pinot pull through or will a young girl be shattered?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well ...try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pearl was at her regular hairdressing appointment when she started bleeding internally. Now the pampered poodle may have minutes to live and Chris is her only hope.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Lucu has been attacked by a paralysis tick and the poison is rapidly shutting down her system. A round the clock watch is needed to keep this innocent victim alive. But will it be enough?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer and will she ever be able to fly?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emotional case for Chris as he fights to save one of the clinic’s favourite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now Bluebell is the victim of a hit run accident and all the staff at Bondi are directly affected.

programme.title: The Confession
programme.desc: All her life, Katie Lapp (Katie LeClerc) has known no other world than that of the Amish family who raised her. But upon discovering that she was actually adopted from out of the "English" world, her quest for answers to her identity resulted in her being shunned by her people. Now in "The Confession," the thrilling sequel to "The Shunning," Katie is on an even greater quest--to be reunited before it is too late with her long-lost birth mother, Laura Mayfield (Sherry Stringfield), who is dying of cancer. Only the challenges of being Amish in an English world stand in her way... along with one man who has other plans for her biological mother's legacy.

As she fights to save both her father and Grant's public image, she falls in love and learns not to judge a book by it's cover.

programme.title: Murder Gardens
programme.desc: Murder Gardens is the story of Chase Washington, a 19-year-old young man whose world has been turned upside down after he leaves a comfortable home provided by his foster father for a life of crime and corruption that he's introduced to by his older brother Rell Washington. Chase ends up in the middle of a war between a notorious crew of drug dealers, corrupt politicians and local law enforcement. Determined to survive and prove that the brain is mightier than the gun, Chase finds a way to outsmart his new found enemies and keep him and his brother Rell out of prison and a graveyard.

programme.title: Buried
programme.desc: After the murder of his fiancée and her lover, Cameron escapes Atlanta under a new identity and loses the trail of the investigators. When he meets Lauren after settling in Florida, his cover begins to crack when a neighbor begins asking questions, and opening secrets that are supposed to be buried.

programme.title: False Profits
programme.desc: Delilah is imprisoned for fraud after being apart of her family’s gospel group which was a front for a ponzi scheme. She agrees to be interviewed by a local reporter about her past and her side of the crime. On the day of the interview, her sister performs a song hinting at hidden truths about her past.

programme.title: The Bayou City Murders
programme.desc: Houston Police Officer Tamara Haynes takes a bold interest in recent murders of women in Houston’s South Side. However, the case are unique and have horrific similarities and there is likely a serial killer on the loose. Then a local prostitute that Tamara has connections to turns up missing, making this investigation personal. When she meets a man that she starts to fall for, the true nature of those involve becomes unmasked.

programme.title: Hoodie Girls Gang
programme.desc: Kayla's boyfriend Jamal is jailed and needs $10,000 bail. Desperate, Kayla and her friends plan an armed robbery. However, the heist goes wrong, and the police are on their trail. To make matters worse, Jamal's boss, Sean, demands payment for the drugs Jamal was transporting. Kayla must now free Jamal and escape town before both the police and Sean catch up to her.

programme.title: You Ain't Gonna Believe This
programme.desc: Following the recent split with her longtime boyfriend Wayne, Jamerial embarks on a journey of a self-exploration and modern dating. Everything looks up until she finds out she might be potentially catfished by a new love interest, so her best friend reaches out to the show “You Ain’t Gonna Believe This” to uncover the truth about this mystery man.

programme.title: You Made Me This Way
programme.desc: Haunted by a failed assassination attempt, ruthless drug lord Kwame becomes obsessed with Aubrey, the woman who nearly ended his life. Consumed by revenge, he kidnaps her, setting in motion a deadly game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: The Jealous Son
programme.desc: Seduced by her boyfriend's charming son, a woman soon finds herself trapped in a dangerous obsession that will push her to her limits.

programme.title: But I'm Married
programme.desc: Kimora and Jamal, a successful power couple, face a dwindling passion in their marriage. Seeking to reignite their spark, Kimora explores unconventional options, including introducing a third person. This decision unleashes a whirlwind of hidden desires, lies, and betrayals. As secrets surface and trust erodes, Kimora must confront the consequences of her choices and rebuild her life, navigating the complexities of desire and the fragility of her marriage.

programme.title: Heart of a Woman
programme.desc: Alisha, a rising model with a bright future, chose to put her career on hold to stand by her football star husband Jax. When an opportunity arises for her to return to the runway, their marriage is put to the test, and whether love or career holds the most weight in their relationship.

programme.title: Somebody's Got to Die
programme.desc: After leading a life of contract killing, Jake makes a promise to his fiancé, Nicole, to go on the straight and narrow. He finds solace in running a bar with his brother Kelvin. When his former Kingpin Marcel offers him a way out, he is forced to confront shadows of his past, and overcome one of the biggest jobs of his criminal career.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.title: Rage: Kill or Be Killed
programme.desc: Jackie “Labrae” Robinson dominates Houston’s unsanctioned boxing circuit—until he comes face-to-face with the one opponent, he never imagined fighting: his personal hero, legendary champion Theo Barnes. However, Theo is a haunted man dealing with his own demons and an advanced case of CTE. A first meeting quickly escalates into an all-out brawl, making the stakes of two champion fighters that much higher.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.title: A Wolf's Cries
programme.desc: Janice is a compulsive liar. In her new friend group, she causes chaos, breaking up couples and getting friends arrested. Believing she deserves everything; it's her way or the highway. Until someone sees her manipulation and aims to expose her.

programme.title: Secure the Bag 2
programme.desc: Greed is Lit's first love. Lit lost his uncle, who practically raised him, over money he stole from bank robbers. Lit decides to go back to the house where he lost his uncle, but Lit is hiding a secret. It wasn't just money he found.

programme.title: The Lies We Tell but the Secrets We Keep: The Last Lie
programme.desc: Obstacles derail Roni and Bri's attempt at a fresh start, but what is done in the dark always come to light.

programme.title: Cruel Ambition
programme.desc: Filmmakers Woodson and Behr seek out local investor Leon to fund their feature film, but find themselves blackballed. Thinking their luck has changed when they stumble on to a jackpot, they find out just how cruel ambition can really be.

programme.title: Devil's Kiss
programme.desc: Jaz and Taz are more than just sisters, they are two street assassins with a taste for money, respect and blood. After killing the brother of a local kingpin, Jaz and Taz find themselves on the run leaving a trail of drugs and betrayal.

programme.title: Judge Knott
programme.desc: A father’s horrible mistake causes a lifetime of pain for his children. His son tries his best to live a normal life, but his childhood trauma follows him into his marriage. He must face his trauma head on to break this generational curse.

programme.title: Deadly Squatters
programme.desc: Eugene and Laura return home from vacation to find that two young siblings have taken up residence in their home, and have now claimed legal rights as squatters. Forced to share their home with two strangers, they must play their wicked games and survive psychological terror as the legal system takes its time.

programme.title: For You I Will
programme.desc: Mikayla is a struggling hopeless romantic. When she meets Jalen, she thinks she’s found the one, but he wants a possession over a partner. He demands her loyalty by asking her for a hit list of all of her ex-boyfriends to secure his love. Will she walk away? Or let her desperation consume her and fall into a deadly trap?

programme.title: Under the Gun
programme.desc: Cam is a troubled street hustler battling addiction, grief, and mounting debt, as his recklessness threatens to dismantle the tight-knit crime family that raised him. When his brother and trusted runner, Jalen, is caught stealing, his punishment sets off a chain reaction of fear, suspicion, and violence.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Karmen, a successful businesswoman is secure and thriving in every part of her life, except for love. She downloads a dating app and seems to have found Mr. Right in Jermaine, but her best friends warn her that he might be a scammer. As Karmen falls deeper, she slowly falls victim to a network of lies and deceit, that could cost her life.

programme.title: Something Old
programme.desc: With her wedding days away, Kara agrees to meet her ex, Malik, for what she swears is just one last goodbye. But Malik isn’t looking for closure—he wants her back, and he’s not taking no for an answer. What starts as a simple meetup at a hotel turns into a dangerous game of obsession and control. As Kara’s fiancé Jordan uncovers the truth with help from her maid of honor, time’s running out.

programme.title: Vices
programme.desc: Simone, a married woman battling anxiety and the lingering shadow of her past alcoholism, escapes to collect her thoughts. When a storm isolates her in her remote cabin, she’s hunted by two forces: the seductive pull of her past addiction, and a cunning serial killer. Surrounded by a web of lies and sin, Simone must face her inner demons before a literal one ends her life.

programme.title: The Last Days of an Escort
programme.desc: Kitty, a struggling escort, agrees to be documented for a film. Her roommate, Star, a more successful escort, reluctantly joins. A new client, Earl, changes their lives forever when he asks to see Kitty and Star together. Kitty's world becomes increasingly dangerous as she navigates the dark underworld of escorting.

programme.title: What Momma Says
programme.desc: Nearly thirty, Paul Thomas, is still living with his mom. When Paul cannot pay his half of the rent, she kicks him out, forcing Paul to sink or swim when it comes to taking care of himself.

programme.title: Rich Intent
programme.desc: 16-year-old Quana yearns to go to her very first concert. When she gets the opportunity to see her favorite artist, her dreams quickly spiral into a horrific nightmare of imprisonment and shady deals.

programme.title: Twisted Marriage
programme.desc: Dexter and Ashley are a married couple, who are close friends with Mary and Paul. On a whim, they decide to swing spouses for the weekend, which leads to questions about their feelings and if their marriages will survive.

programme.title: Garrett Morris and Michael Schultz
programme.desc: The story of the careers of legendary actor Garrett Morrison and legendary movie director Michael Schultz. Follow their life and career from their early beginnings to adulthood and becoming worldwide legendary artists from Broadway to Hollywood.

programme.title: Dream on Dreamer
programme.desc: Mario's life unravels when he quits med school for acting, angering his wife, Erica, who leaves with their daughter. His friend Derrick faces his own crisis with his side chick. Desperate, they turn to Mario's drug-dealing brother, Paul. This leads them into the dangerous world of Queen Pin Malkia, where their lives are put at risk.

programme.title: Father Knows Best
programme.desc: Zoe Miles, raised by a controlling father who introduces her to a life of crime, grapples with the lingering trauma of her mother's death. Yearning to embrace the spiritual life she shared with her grandmother, Zoe finds herself trapped in a cycle of violence, forced to rob drug dealers after witnessing a terrifying crime. Desperate to escape this destructive path, she struggles against her father's suffocating control, fearing the loss of his approval and the validation she desperately seeks.

programme.title: Carmen and Magic
programme.desc: When Carmen meets a new friend at school named Magic, she helps raise her spirits and allows her to stand up for herself. When her single father Drew starts seeing the school principal, Magic convinces Carmen to disrupt their relationship, pulling the veil on Magic’s sinister nature.

programme.title: Droppin Bodies
programme.desc: Julia, a mother haunted by a violent past, flees her old life to protect her daughter, Kelsey. But when Kelsey is tragically murdered by her boyfriend, Julia is left shattered and betrayed. Abandoned by a justice system that fails to bring her daughter's killer to account, she's forced to confront the darkness she once escaped.

programme.title: Commandments of a Female Hustler
programme.desc: Three childhood friends, Lala, Binky, and Jay grew up together on the streets of East Baltimore. Wanting a better life for themselves, they learn the ways of hustling. When they align themselves with one of the most powerful drug dealers in the game, their loyalties are tested, and the very commandments that once bound them start to break.

programme.title: Unsecured
programme.desc: Bobby, haunted by the infidelity of his ex-wife, enters a new relationship with Lakeisha while grappling with deep-seated insecurities. Unbeknownst to Lakeisha, his past resurfaces when a witness claims to have seen him involved in a murder.

programme.title: For All Have Sinned
programme.desc: After the sudden death of his mother, Mano embarks on a violent path that stems from his grief and causes him to spiral. He lives by the mantra of Romans 3:23 “for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” When a local church members attempts to reach him, he finds a way to navigate his pain and grief.

programme.title: Only 48
programme.desc: When Tracy Harris is abducted and held for ransom, her father Keith has only 48 hours to deliver $500,000. Forced back into the criminal world he tried to escape; Keith faces dangerous alliances and hidden truths in order to save his daughter.

programme.title: Gigalow
programme.desc: Diamond White, a college graduate drowning in debt and raising his younger sister, turns to dancing for survival. After moving to Texas, he joins Midnight, an underground male club, and quickly rises to the top. But as money and temptation pull him deeper, Diamond must choose between responsibility and a lifestyle that could cost him everything.

programme.desc: A unique, undercover look at Robot Wars Series 2. Featuring exclusive footage from the teams and highlights from the battles.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Witness the human drama of competitor’s desperation for victory and the resulting mechanical carnage.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of teams all over the country as they battle it out in hopes of becoming champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The pace steps up a gear as Philippa investigates behind the scenes of the series’ first Semi-finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The second round of semi-finals follows six more teams that have made it through the heats and are one step closer to Grand Final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four robotic warriors have battled their way to the Grand Final. The other competitors have been sent to a scrapheap. See what it’s like behind the scenes of the most intense stage of the competition.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Learn more about this infamous Robot and the family that built it. With an unforgettable design and devastating weapon, this competitor became an instant icon.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Debuting in the Second Wars, to becoming the most successful Robot ever to take part in Robot Wars. This Robot put the squeeze on all the competition, including the House Robots.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Newcomers, veterans and a recent President enter the fray in this first Heat of the series. Competitors are eliminated left, right and centre and only the strongest will survive to compete in the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A veteran only heat features the current reigning Champions, Carbide. Will Carbide’s streak be brought to an end by the other robots, more experienced and eager than ever?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even the judges aren’t safe as two robots collide, sending shrapnel through the bullet-resistant shields around the arena. Two very different styles of robot meet in the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer stares down seven veterans, will their induction into the arena be successful, or will their inexperience find them in the pit? One robot will have a second chance to qualify in the Redemption Round.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The final heat features only veterans, here for an opportunity to make up for their mistakes in the previous tournaments. Only one competitor will make it into the Grand Finals, and the others must suffer defeat, again.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: After lengthy repairs and inspirational pep talks, the qualifiers prepare to fight for the title. A 10-way Robot Rumble will give the victor a spot in the Grand Finals, alongside the heat winners.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six robots come to the arena to try and best the challenges that await, including Skittles, where they must act as an autonomous bowling ball to knock over as many barrels as they can, whilst trying to avoid the house robots.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors have a chance to go head-to-head with a house robot in a test of strength and strategy in this week’s trial, tug of war. Winners progress to the next round, losers take a face first dive into the pit.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This week’s trial takes the competitors back in time to medieval England, where they will joust against an unyielding house robot in hopes of winning a chance at the crown. The house robots team up to take down an unlucky competitor in the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Football returns to the arena in this week’s trial, complete with ferocious tackles, flamethrowers and own goals. In the semi-final, three of the house robots turn the arena into a barbeque.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals? A winner is decided by the pit in this week’s final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The gauntlet has a menacing addition, The Sentinel. Will the new robot prove to be a real obstacle, or an easy route to be exploited? The Skittles trial returns to the arena, but one competitor wants to take down more than just barrels.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Football returns this week in the trial. New competitors enter the arena with high hopes of securing a place in the finals. The house robots show no mercy in the Gauntlet.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Matilda’s tusks get put to good use against the competitors as jousting returns to the arena. Two competitors form a rivalry after a memorable battle in the semi-finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Matilda takes centre stage again, as she attempts to pull as many competitors into the pit as possible in another tug of war. How will the competitors fair against the hazards of the arena and the merciless house robots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors are once again tasked with defending their land in King of the Castle, will they defend their reign or be overthrown by the house robots? An even match in the semi-finals causes the house robots to forcefully decide a winner.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Dead Metal takes to the ring to stop any competitors from progressing to the stage of the competition.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: First of the two Semi-Finals to determine which two of the six heat winners will progress to The Second Wars Grand Finals. The house robots are showing no mercy in the gauntlet and the competitors test their accuracy in this week’s trial, Pinball.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last Semi-Final, competitors will once again battle the house robots in Pinball, evade them in the gauntlet and use them to destroy other competitors in the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Grand Final arrives, only the best robots have made it this far. The four remaining robots face two eliminators and a playoff. The two winners then face each other to determine who will be named champion of Robot Wars: The Second wars.

programme.desc: The Grudge Matches gave competitors an opportunity to come back and settle some scores. A one-off episode featuring a variety of battles; Judgement Day, Reserve Rumble, Inferno Insurrection, Ramrombit, Super Showdown and Internet Insurrection.

programme.desc: A line is an infinitely extending one-dimensional figure; one that has length but not width or thickness. In art lines are the basis that give form to a piece of art. Projects featuring lines: a modern art canvas with paint and masking tape; lines become three dimensional as we make a playhouse for dolls or action figures; continue with your art journal and use brightly colored pens and a special tool to make spirograph line drawings. Finally make an unbreakable stained glass plaque with foil.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Drill Charging Station
programme.desc: Back in 2010 I built a Drill Charging Station to show off a new joinery gadget. It was really simple and didn't quite have a feature set outside of being two shelves on the wall. So only eight short years later I finally decided to build a proper Drill Charging Station, made from Baltic Birch plywood featuring all the storage I need for 5 drills, two chargers, and all of my bits and accessories.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: DIY Kids School Desk - Quick - Easy - Inexpensive!
programme.desc: A one-day build using 1/4 sheet of plywood and a 2x4.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Knock Down Trestle Table Part 1
programme.desc: The table is a trestle design which keeps the legs out of the way and gives us plenty of overhang. The joinery is all mortise and tenon including some cool double wedged mortise and tenon joints. I even added extra supports in the middle of the table that will not only support the top but should also help keep the table top flat over time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Woven Panel Rolling Hamper Part 2
programme.desc: The hamper is assembled, hinges are added, casters are attached, finish is applied, and snaps are installed on the cotton bags.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Tricked Out Bandsaws Featuring Carter Products
programme.desc: The bandsaw is one of my favorite tools and if you treat it well, it will quickly become one of your favorites as well. While most modern bandsaws come with decent components, to begin with, there are companies like Carter Products who make high-quality after-market add-ons that can make your bandsaw better performing and easier to adjust. One of the best upgrades you can do is replacing the guide

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cutting Thin Strips at the Table Saw
programme.desc: Resawing thin stock and cutting thin strips is typically the domain of the bandsaw. And while I consider the bandsaw to be an essential shop tool, not everyone has one. So it's probably worth considering an alternative option that kills two birds with one stone: utilizing a more common tool that results in a smoother cut.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Protecting Outdoor Furniture with Epoxy Feet
programme.desc: Mother Nature always wins. So when you make outdoor furniture you have two choices: commit to a regular maintenance schedule or come to terms with the weathered gray look. An easy thing you can do to help the cause is to prevent moisture from entering into the legs. This simple trick requires nothing more than epoxy and masking tape.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Trestle Table Part 2
programme.desc: Now that the leg pieces are cut to their rough shape, we need to focus on blending the parts using an assortment of tools including a router, a ball mill, and a cabinet-maker’s rasp. You’ll notice that much of the sculpting work is done before the glueup. I find it much easier to work on these parts in smaller pieces rather than trying to work the entire finished leg at once.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: AWFS 2007 Special - Part 1 of 2
programme.desc: Special episode of The Wood Whisperer on location at AWFS fair in Los Vegas!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Interview with Kaleo Kala
programme.desc: A chat with woodworker and designer, Kaleo Kala.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Buy This Not That - Measuring and Marking
programme.desc: Tools I think you should buy as well as tools I think you should avoid.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Bit Storage Cabinet
programme.desc: A wall-hanging cabinet to help you organize and store your drill and router bits.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 60 Seconds to Sharp
programme.desc: Most videos about sharpening, including my own, focus on how to tune up an old tool or properly set a new one. Thankfully, once you do that process it isn't likely you'll have to do it again for a very long time. From that point on, you'll be sharpening in maintenance mode.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: You Don't Need Breadboard Ends - Ask TWW
programme.desc: You don't need breadboard ends - and that's why.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Urea Resin Woodworking Glues
programme.desc: We take a look at urea resin woodworking glues. These glues definitely have their advantages: low water content, gap-filling, long open time, and rigid glue lines just to name a few. But keep in mind the one big disadvantage: safety. These glues are pretty nasty and you might be best served considering other options. But with proper precautions, this glue can be a nice addition to your shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Don’t Make These Lumber Mistakes!
programme.desc: A few tips that will make your life easier when buying and using lumber and plywood.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lumber Rack aka Racking My Brain
programme.desc: The lumber rack is the unsung hero of the woodworking shop. Its responsible for holding our raw materials safely, securely, and in an organized fashion until we're ready to use them.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Making Raised Panel Doors aka Raising Arizona
programme.desc: Every well-rounded woodworker should know how to make raised panels doors! In this episode, Marc help you to learn or refresh your memory on making cool panel doors.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Crooked Garden Gate
programme.desc: Building a garden gate for a space that's anything but square.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A $35 Hand Plane? Ask TWW
programme.desc: Thoughts on Grizzly's planes? Coping Sleds. Problem with Tung Oil Finish. Fesool Sanders 3 vs 5 Stroke How to Soundproof the Shop. What are your greatest influences? Glue for Vacuum Pressing. Filling Epoxy Gaps Is Carbon Filtration Helpful? Is CNC a novelty?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: VerySuperCool Tools After-Market Tablesaw Fence
programme.desc: The guys over at VerySuperCool Tools recently gave me an opportunity to test out one of their new products: an after-market fence system. The great thing about this unit is that it works perfectly with existing Biesemeyer-style fences. So installation is as simple as dropping it on the rail and performing a standard fence calibration.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Better Way to Apply Oil Finishes!
programme.desc: Applying oil finishes sparingly is the key to avoiding problems with curing and other flaws in the surface.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rubbing Out a High Gloss Finish
programme.desc: One of the biggest challenges woodworkers face is getting a nice smooth blemish-free finish. Let's face it, very few of us have spray booths and our shops are far from ideal finishing environments. It's to be expected that our finish will nearly always have dust and other pieces of debris residing within it. Fortunately, there is a way that just about any finish can be improved.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.desc: Experience the electric intensity of the "Maharashtra derby" as local rivals Pune United and Mumbai Pickle Power clash at the Jio World Garden in a match hailed as one of the season's best. Mumbai ignites the home crowd with a dominant early lead, fueled by Jada Bui’s emotional victory over a "fearful" Katie Morris and a clinical masterclass from Brandon and Glauca Carvajal Lane in mixed doubles. However, the tide turns in a dramatic "tale of two halves" as Pune United mounts a stunning comeback. Witness the high-power precision of Bolin Bako as he derails Max Green’s momentum, sparking a relentless surge that sees Pune sweep the final three matches to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. This tie is a masterclass in team resilience and tactical pressure under the lights in Mumbai.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, concludes its first day with the historic Men's Singles Open Final under the floodlights. England's captain James Chaudry, the only active European player with a DUPR rating over 6.0, faces off against Poland's Bartosz Karbownik (referred to as Kabosnik/Kabashnik in audio).Chaudry dominates early with a mix of power and precise cross-court angles, taking the first game decisively. While Karbownik produces moments of brilliance, including a spectacular passing shot, he struggles with his footing on the clay surface. Witness Team England secure the gold medal in the inaugural singles event of the championships.

programme.title: The Cast
